sections.heading: First Run, First Feel
sections.body: On first run, we make one promise clear and deliver one quick win. We avoid overwhelming tours. Instead we set a small goal and help users reach it in under a minute.

sections.heading: Scaffolding that Disappears
sections.body: Tooltips and hints fade as confidence grows. We detect success and remove scaffolding to reduce clutter. Users should feel the app is learning with them.

sections.heading: Personalization not Profiling
sections.body: We ask a few meaningful questions, not a survey. Answers shape defaults and content. We are upfront about how choices will be used and offer a reset path.

sections.heading: Repair-Friendly Onboarding
sections.body: If sign-up fails, we keep entered data, explain the issue, and offer alternatives: magic links, social sign-in, or passwordless options. We never make users retype everything.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Design a 3-step onboarding with a quick win at step 2. Write copy for an error that occurs at step 1 that preserves momentum and dignity.
